scripts.prod:up: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --profile job build && docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.git:clean: echo 'Cleaning up deleted remote branches...' && git fetch -p && git branch -vv | grep ': gone]' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r git branch -D && echo 'Cleanup done.'
scripts.git:prod-update: git fetch origin && git checkout production && git reset --hard origin/master && git push origin production --force-with-lease && git checkout master && echo '🚀 Production aligned with master!'
